feeding_claim.verbatim: Our animals are raised on pasture

farmers_markets: Covington Farmers Market, Saturdays 9 am to 1 pm, 3rd and Greenup St, Covington KY
notes: Read What We Do, Purchasing (The Basics) and Sustainability pages on the farm's Squarespace site (rachel-breeden-xcfg.squarespace.com; farm email domain is hamptonridgefarm.com, so the Verifier should check whether www.hamptonridgefarm.com resolves to the same site and swap the website URL). Address 2544 Eagle Tunnel Road, Glencoe, KY 41046 shown on site. Purchasing page says no whole, half or bulk purchasing for now; items sold a la carte at the Covington Farmers Market Saturdays 9 to 1, or call to buy at the farm. In-stock list is chicken and pork cuts plus eggs; turkeys and ducks also raised. Farm has cattle (cattle get fresh grass daily in season, hay and non-GMO alfalfa pellets in winter) but beef was not on the in-stock list, so beef left out of species. Pigs rotated through woods with local non-GMO grain; poultry on pasture in moved hutches with non-GMO ration.
